# assignmentB2iriscaglayan

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of assignmentB2iriscaglayan is to count the number of missing values for all columns in a dataset grouped by a specified column.

## Installation

You can install the development version of assignmentB2 from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:
devtools::install_github(
  "UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2iriscaglayan",
  ref = "0.1.0"
)

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2iriscaglayan")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2iriscaglayan)
## basic example code
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```
